extractions.description: The paper introduces the Unsupervised Dependency Graph Network (UDGN), a model designed for inducing dependency structures from raw corpora. By leveraging a masked language modeling task, UDGN achieves impressive performance in unsupervised dependency parsing without utilizing gold Part-of-Speech (POS) tags or external information. The model enhances self-attention heads to model different dependency relations, allowing it to learn and perform well on semantic tasks while maintaining strong correlations with human-annotated dependency types.
